verdict.rationale: Airbyte's core value prop is a large connector catalog (600+/700+ sources) with standardized destinations covering Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, and object storage/lakes, using consistent sync modes, schema handling, and typing/deduping so pipelines aren't rewritten per destination; deployment flexibility (OSS, abctl, Kubernetes) supports portability across environments. Community evidence corroborates real-world use for consolidating varied sources (comm-4, comm-5, comm-7) though with some friction (comm-1, comm-4 workaround for huge tables). Missing for 10: explicit named case studies confirming identical pipeline definitions ported across Snowflake/BigQuery/Databricks specifically, and no independent benchmark on destination parity/feature completeness across those specific warehouses.
